mapper.insert: INSERT INTO StudentDEMS(StudentId, StudentName, Department, Password) VALUES(#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{department}, #{password})
mapper.update: UPDATE StudentDEMS SET StudentName=#{studentName}, Department=#{department} WHERE StudentId=#{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM StudentDEMS ORDER BY CreateTime DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE StudentDEMS SET Balance = Balance + #{amount} WHERE StudentId=#{studentId}
UPDATE StudentDEMS SET Password=#{password} WHERE StudentId=#{studentId}
UPDATE StudentDEMS SET IsLost=#{isLost} WHERE StudentId=#{studentId}
